Other clubs that were merged throughout history to form the current club include [[CA Spora Luxembourg]], [[Sporting Club Luxembourg]], [[CS Hollerich]], [[CS Alliance 01]], [[FC Aris Bonnevoie]], [[US Hollerich Bonnevoie]] and [[Jeunesse Sportive Verlorenkost]]."}}
